ios.name: Pictoos: Image Toolbox
ios.subtitle: Compare, resize & brighten
ios.promotional_text: Crop, compare and batch convert in one workspace. Choose JPEG/WebP quality or lossless WebP, then save a new copy while keeping your original.
ios.description:
Get photos, screenshots and design assets into the dimensions and formats you need. Pictools brings cropping, resizing, comparison, brightness enhancement and batch conversion into one on-device workspace. No account required.

CROP AND RESIZE PRECISELY
Enter a width and height, lock proportions or choose a crop ratio. Prepare copies for profile pictures, posts and design projects.

COMPARE TWO IMAGES
Inspect differences with slider, side-by-side and overlay views. Compare a brightened image with the original before saving.

CONVERT A BATCH
Export PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, ICO and TIFF. Set JPEG/WebP quality or choose lossless WebP. Pick a background when converting transparency to JPG. Follow each item's processing status and save completed results.

Choose images from Photos or Files. Save PNG/JPG to Photos, save any of the six formats to Files, or use the system share sheet. Results are saved as new copies. The workspace adapts to iPhone and iPad screens.

Image processing happens on your device. Pictools does not upload your images to us and requires no sign-in. It includes no ads or tracking SDKs. Choose a light, dark or system theme. The interface supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Spanish, French and German.
